subject: pri-info
title: (R)PRI.INFO.------INFO.DY.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-13 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's call to read 'high culture' through affinity-dynamics rather than applied empiricism: 'the individual brilliance that has underlined how given culture groups attain high culture … has more to do with the realness of affinity dynamics than any notion of superiority.' (R)PRI-INFO (the reality of principle information) is crossed with INFO-DY (information dynamics): the question is what principle-information produces in its real instantiation when crossed with information-dynamics. The (R) prefix on the subject is load-bearing — Braxton commits here that principle-information *actually* exists across cultures, not merely conceptually. TH-CONT (thrust continuance) sits at a dot on the main line between subject and partner. From the stretch toward the partner hang ATTN (attraction) and RT-DY (reality dynamics); RT-DY carries PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and ACT-TR (actual transformation). ACT-TR carries INFO-PROJ (information projection) and CUL-TR-S (cultural transfer shifts), which leads to AFI (affinity insight).
